routes_inv_allowlist_url_description: Matches on scheme, host, port, and path prefix. Query strings and fragments are not allowed.
routes_inv_allowlist_version_description: Leave empty to allow any version. Pinning a version re-blocks the server when it is upgraded.
routes_inv_allowlist_hostname_descriptio: Allows any MCP server on this hostname, over any path or port.
routes_inv_allowlist_connector_descripti: The connector's display name, matched without regard to case. Use this for MCP connectors that expose no local URL or command, such as claude.ai Connectors (i.e. claude.ai Google Calendar). claude.ai Connectors always have the format "claude.ai <name>".
routes_inv_allowlist_tool_placeholder: Add a tool name and press Enter
routes_inv_allowlist_tools_description: Leave empty to allow every tool on this server. Enforcement never looks at the arguments passed to a tool.
routes_inv_enrollment_keys_description: Keys used by Obot Sentry to register a new device with Obot.
routes_inv_no_enrollment_keys: No enrollment keys. New devices cannot enroll until you create one.
routes_inv_expiration_default: Defaults to one year from today.
routes_inv_revoke_key_msg: Revoke enrollment key "{name}"? New devices can no longer enroll with it; already-enrolled devices are unaffected.
routes_inv_key_shown_once: This is the only time the enrollment key is shown. Distribute it through your MDM configuration; if you lose it, revoke this key and create a new one.
routes_inv_getting_started_subtitle: Enable user device scanning, local agent audit logs, and more
routes_inv_readonly_create_note: An administrator with write access must create the initial configuration.
routes_inv_enforce_tool_calls: Enforce tool calls on enrolled devices
routes_inv_getting_started_enforce_descr: Blocks tool calls that aren't on the allowlist. Starts with Obot-hosted MCP servers and built-in agent tools allowed. Requires installing the Obot Sentry package on your devices. This feature is experimental and is not recommended for production use — a misconfigured allowlist blocks real work on every enrolled device.

routes_inv_enforcement_description: Control exactly which tool calls enrolled devices may execute. Calls that aren't allowed are blocked on the device.
routes_inv_enforcement_toggle_descriptio: Installs enforcement hooks alongside Obot Sentry. Every tool call is checked against the rules below before it runs. This feature is experimental and is not recommended for production use — a misconfigured allowlist blocks real work on every enrolled device.
routes_inv_reinstall_note: Enforcement hooks are installed by the Obot Sentry package. Re-download the install package above and reinstall it on your devices for this change to take effect.
routes_inv_seeded_note: Started you off with a default policy. Review it and save, or adjust it first.
routes_inv_not_enforced: Not currently enforced — these rules take effect when enforcement is enabled.
routes_inv_all_obot_hosted_description: Any MCP server hosted by this Obot instance.
routes_inv_all_builtin_tools_description: The agent's own tools, like reading files, writing files, and running shell commands.
routes_inv_all_builtin_mcp_description: MCP servers that ship inside the coding agent itself.
routes_inv_everything_description: Allows every tool call and ignores all other rules.
routes_inv_everything_on_note: All other rules are ignored while "Everything" is on.
routes_inv_no_allowed_servers: No specific MCP servers allowed. Add one to allow calls to a server that isn't covered by the rules above.
routes_inv_blocks_everything: Enforcement is enabled but nothing is allowed. Every tool call on every enrolled device will be blocked.
routes_inv_add_rules_anytime: You can add rules at any time.
routes_inv_remove_allowed_msg: Remove "{server}" from the allowlist? Calls to it will be blocked unless another rule allows them.
routes_inv_takes_effect_on_save: This takes effect when you save.
